tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (11.4:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, interactive elements. Used as background on `.header`, `.btn-primary`; text on `.stat-icon.blue`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-tertiary`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.nav-link:hover, .nav-link:focus`, `.btn-primary:hover, .btn-primary:focus`; text on `.badge-primary`. 4.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Alerts, destructive actions, hot metrics. Used as text on `.stat-icon.coral`, `.stat-change.negative`. 2.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success states, positive metrics, confirmations. Used as text on `.stat-icon.mint`, `.stat-change.positive`. 1.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Backgrounds, card surfaces, clean space. Used as text on `.header`, `.logo`, `.nav-link`; background on `.stat-card`, `.card`, `.btn-secondary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text, headers, strong contrast elements. Used as text on `body`, `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6`, `.stat-value`; background on `.footer`. 11.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-50
tokens.usage: , very light gray (#F7FAFC) for contrast. Used as background on `body`, `.btn-secondary:hover, .btn-secondary:focus`, `.btn-tertiary:hover, .btn-tertiary:focus`.

tokens.name: color-gray-300
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-link`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-600
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-description`, `.form-help`. 3.8:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
